description: Single full-body native pixel-art game sprite. IDENTITY MUST MATCH: Adult woman, natural slender build, oval face and warm restrained smile, narrow muted brown-gray eyes. Dark brown hair center-parted with long curved cheek-length side locks, gathered in a low rounded bun behind head. Navy-blue fitted single-breasted trouser suit, white shirt, navy tie. Bare face, no mask or glasses. Thin plain rings on fingers. Relaxed upright SOUTH-facing stance, empty hands visible at sides, low top-down camera. Natural adult anatomy and normal torso/pelvis. Anatomical crown-to-sole height 200-206px on128x256, hair/cap excluded from body height. Soles at y248, leave unused space above shorter people, NEVER enlarge to fill canvas. Keep original individual body shape. Match style reference ONLY for crisp native1px clusters, selective dark outlines and controlled shading; own colors and clothes. Transparent background, no shadow, no text, no weapons. Entire hair and shoes inside frame.
